product.title: Biblia. O istorie ilustrată
product.description: O introducere de o mare acurateţe în credinţele şi identitatea iudeo-creştină, Biblia – o istorie ilustrată oferă o serie de istorisiri pilduitoare, cu ample citate din Cartea Sfântă, susţinute de un bogat material iconografic – peste 1 000 de imagini color şi alb-negru. Poveştile şi personajele Bibliei prind viaţă în fiecare pagină – de la crearea omului din Adam şi Eva în grădina raiului la răspândirea Evangheliilor, de la supusul întru credinţă Avraam la înţeleptul Solomon, de la episodul Exodului la Ioan Botezătorul, Salomeea sau Iisus. Cuprinzând scene şi eroi atât din Vechiul cât şi din Noul Testament, această carte uşor de citit se adresează întregii familii şi ne înfăţişează o sintetică privire de ansamblu asupra obiceiurilor, sărbătorilor, scrierilor şi ideilor care izvorăsc din Biblie. Accesibilă, fascinantă şi de mare autoritate, Biblia – o istorie ilustrată este o lectură esenţială pentru cei pasionaţi de aventura cunoaşterii mentalităţilor şi civilizaţiilor.

# Illustrated Bible Story: A Journey Through Faith and History by Litera

Discover an introduction of great accuracy into Jewish-Christian beliefs and identity with the **Illustrated Bible Story**. Published by Litera, this book transforms the profound narratives of the Holy Scripture into a visually rich and accessible journey through history. If you are passionate about the adventure of knowledge concerning civilizations and mentalities, this illustrated edition is an essential reading for exploring the core ideas that have shaped human civilization.

## A Visual Tapestry of Scripture

What sets the *Illustrated Bible Story* apart is its commitment to visual storytelling. This book offers a series of compelling historical narratives supported by a rich collection of iconography. You will find over 1,000 images, presented in both color and black and white, bringing the stories and characters of the Bible vividly to life on every page.

These illustrations are not mere decorations; they serve as powerful tools for understanding the complex history, customs, writings, and ideas that flow from the Bible. By seeing the events unfold through art, readers can connect more deeply with the epic scope of the divine narratives.

## Exploring the Scope of History

This book offers a comprehensive, yet easy-to-read, overview spanning both the Old and New Testaments. It invites you to follow pivotal figures and momentous events that define the trajectory of faith and civilization:

*   **The Beginning:** Journey back to the creation of man in the Garden of Eden, tracing the lineage from Adam and Eve.
*   **Foundational Figures:** Follow the epic stories of Abrahamâs submission to faith and the wisdom of Solomon, exploring the origins of major religious concepts.
*   **Defining Events:** Experience the dramatic unfolding of pivotal episodes such as the Exodus, the ministry of John the Baptist, the life of Salome, and the arrival of Jesus.
*   **The Core Teachings:** Explore the spread of the Gospels and understand the customs, holidays, and core ideas that have emerged from the sacred texts.

This illustrated format makes complex theological concepts accessible to everyone, regardless of prior knowledge. It provides a succinct yet profound look at the history embedded within the Bible, making it an ideal resource for families, students, and anyone seeking a deeper understanding of these foundational narratives.

## Why Choose the Illustrated Edition?

The **Illustrated Bible Story** by Litera is more than just a religious text; it is an educational adventure. It appeals to those who seek depth, visual engagement, and authoritative knowledge simultaneously. The combination of accurate historical recounting and abundant artistic representation ensures that the stories of the Old Testament and New Testamentâfrom the earliest creation to the life of Christâare not just read, but experienced.

This book serves as an excellent starting point for anyone interested in the intersection of history, culture, and spirituality. It is a fascinating and authoritative resource that brings the richness of biblical history into sharp focus through beautiful imagery.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Who is the target audience for this illustrated Bible story?**
A: This book is designed to be accessible and engaging, making it ideal for families, students, and anyone interested in learning about the history, customs, and core ideas of Judaism and Christianity.

**Q: How much visual content is included in the book?**
A: The book features a rich collection of over 1,000 illustrations, presented in both color and black and white, to vividly depict the biblical stories and characters.

**Q: Does this book cover the entire Bible?**
A: Yes, the book covers important stories and figures from both the Old Testament and the New Testament, offering a comprehensive overview of key events and teachings.
